top_signals.title: Saudi Arabia Becomes the Oil Market’s Biggest Wild Card
top_signals.summary: Houthi attacks threaten Saudi oil infrastructure and Gulf shipping as Brent hovers near $105 per barrel. Trump’s Fuel-Price Problem Is Becoming a Political One - The Trump administration’s Russia diesel deal has failed to bring about substantial change in US fuel prices, triggering a 3-4% decline in heating oil futures, raising the risks of a midterm election debacle for the White House.  - Whilst neither diesel nor heating oil have surpassed the levels seen in October 2022 (the month before President Biden’s mid-term elections)…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: French supermarket fridges get hacked, heating to 122°F and sparking fires
top_signals.summary: Hackers targeted hundreds of French supermarkets in a large-scale cyberattack, causing refrigerators to overheat, spoiling food, and sparking fires.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Cass: TL linehaul rates up 10% in September, shipment counts remain positive
top_signals.summary:
September data from Cass showed truckload linehaul rates rose 10% and freight shipments grew for the second consecutive month following a 42-month downturn.
